summary: Collect sos reports from every containerized AAP host by running the ansible.containerized_installer.log_gathering playbook.
questions: How do I gather logs for Red Hat support from containerized AAP?
How do I create an sos report for AAP?

answer_card.title: Gather sos reports
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i <inventory> ansible.containerized_installer.log_gathering
# add -e upload=true to upload to Red Hat
```
